faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Are the first 7 days really free?
faq.a1: Yes, on any plan, monthly or yearly, the first time. You pay {cero} today and we email you the charge notice today, with the date and the amount. If you don’t want to continue, cancel in 1 click before that date and you’re not charged.
faq.q2: How much do I pay after the 7 days?
faq.a2: Pro costs {pro_mes} MXN a month or {pro_anual} MXN a year, VAT included. We email you before every renewal.
faq.a2Month: Pro costs {pro_mes} MXN a month, VAT included. We email you before every renewal.
faq.a2Year: Pro costs {pro_anual} MXN a year, VAT included. We email you before every renewal.
faq.a3: Go to My account → My plan → Cancel. It’s 1 click and 1 confirmation, no calls. You keep your plan until the end of the period you paid for.
faq.a4: No. Each tool guides you in 3 steps, with big buttons and simple words.
faq.a5: Every tool: {lista}, with new credits every month. No extra payments.
faq.a5NoClaim: Chalyb’s tools, with new credits every month.
faq.q6: Do the Signals tell me what to invest in?
faq.a6: No. They’re informational alerts, the same for everyone, and they don’t use your balances or investments. They aren’t financial advice: you decide.
faq.a7: With a credit or debit card, securely through Mercado Pago. Chalyb doesn’t store your card number.
faq.a8: Yes. From My account → My plan you can go from monthly to yearly, move up to VIP or go back to Free anytime.
faq.a8OneInterval: Yes. From My account → My plan you can move up to VIP or go back to Free anytime.
